{{Top|leg}}
'''Callis Beck''' was an [[Detective/Legends|investigator]] and [[Skip tracer/Legends|skip tracer]] working on [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]]. Beck was hired by [[ComNet Corporation]]. For a fee of 20,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], Beck was hired to locate a being known as "[[Stoneheart]]."

Beck had one lead; a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] reportedly owned by Stoneheart was in [[Ord Mynock Freeport]], and that the passage to [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was paid for by the [[Antiques dealer/Legends|antiquities dealer]] [[Leezoth]].
